caption_recommended:
we are not perfect at the love we believe in.

some days patience comes late.
sorry comes as a cup.
forever becomes one repaired evening.

maybe the point is not never repeating the pattern.
maybe it is noticing sooner,
and coming back softer.
caption_alt: for the couples who are still learning the love they keep choosing.
alt_text: Slide 1: we talk about healthy love, but we still learn it mid-fight.
Slide 2: we talk about patience, but sometimes our tone arrives first.
Slide 3: we talk about listening, but sometimes we just don't listen at all.
Slide 4: we talk about giving space, but still always irritate the hell out of each other.
Slide 5: we talk about saying sorry, but never apologies when we should.
Slide 6: we talk about forever, but we fight like we don't know each other.
Slide 7: maybe love is noticing the pattern, and choosing softness sooner.
